resources.string: Your next reminders and a button to add one
All your data stays on your phone. Remember Me has no internet permission, so it sends nothing anywhere and collects no statistics.
Some phones stop background apps to save battery. If a reminder is ever late, come back to this page.
You haven\'t saved a backup for a month.

A reminder when it is due. It follows silent, vibrate and Do Not Disturb. Remember Me plays the tone you chose.
A reminder that rings at alarm volume even when the phone is silent. It respects Do Not Disturb.
A quiet notice with today\'s number of reminders, if you turn it on.
Backup: used when the tone cannot be played, so a reminder is never silent by accident.
Reminders you were already alerted to that are still waiting, without sound.
A quiet notice before a reminder is due.

Plays the notification sound when it\'s time.

Xiaomi (HyperOS or MIUI): Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Remember Me: turn on Autostart, then Battery saver → No restrictions. In recent apps, long-press Remember Me and tap the lock. (Menu names differ a little between versions.)

Samsung (One UI): Settings → Apps → Remember Me → Battery → Unrestricted. Then Settings → Battery → Background usage limits: add Remember Me to Never sleeping apps and make sure it is not in Sleeping apps.
Huawei and Honor (EMUI, MagicOS or HarmonyOS): Settings → Battery → App launch → Remember Me: turn off Manage automatically and turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
Settings → Battery → Remember Me: Allow background activity. Then turn on Auto launch in app management, and lock Remember Me in recent apps.
Settings → Battery → High background power consumption: allow Remember Me. Then i Manager → App manager → Autostart: turn it on.
This time has passed: the reminder will show as soon as you save.
Remember Me did not get the restart signal after the phone last started: the phone maker blocks it. Turn on Autostart for Remember Me, or reminders are set again only when you open the app.
Remember Me\'s background activity is restricted in Android\'s settings, so alarms may not run. Open App info → Battery → Unrestricted.
Your data was saved by a newer Remember Me. Update the app; nothing in it was changed.
The schedule has not been checked yet.
Exact alarms are not allowed: a reminder may arrive a few minutes late.
Last set again after a restart: %1$s.
Some phones stop apps in the background. Open the battery optimisation list and set Remember Me to Not optimised or Unrestricted.
A test reminder from Remember Me
If you see this, notifications work. Tap Done to check the buttons.
The full-screen reminder showed. Tap Done to finish the test.
Add your first reminder. It will reach you on time, even when the phone is locked.
Android only: becomes one-time in Remember Me for Windows

Rings at alarm volume even on a silent phone, until you deal with it. It does not get through Do Not Disturb unless you allow it.

A copy kept inside the app

Android put Remember Me in the “restricted” group because it was not opened for days

Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Remember Me: turn on “Autostart”.
On the same Remember Me page: “Battery saver” → “No restrictions”.
Open recent apps, long-press Remember Me and choose the lock.
One UI 6 or later: Settings → Device care → Battery → Background usage limits → “Never auto sleeping apps”: add Remember Me.
One UI 5: Settings → Battery and device care → Battery → Background usage limits → “Never sleeping apps”: add Remember Me.
Settings → Battery → App launch → Remember Me: turn off “Manage automatically” and allow auto-launch, secondary launch and run in background.
Settings → Battery → Remember Me: “Allow background activity”.
App management → Remember Me: turn on “Auto launch”.
Settings → Battery → High background power consumption: allow Remember Me.
i Manager → App manager → Autostart: turn it on for Remember Me.

Vibration is off in the settings
The phone is silent: a normal reminder will only vibrate.
The phone is on vibrate: a normal reminder will only vibrate.
Do Not Disturb is on: a normal reminder stays silent.
Do Not Disturb blocks alarms: nothing will ring.
This type\'s channel is muted in Android settings, so no sound was played.
Sound is off in Remember Me\'s settings.
Important alarms and Do Not Disturb
Remember Me never gets through Do Not Disturb on its own. To let important alarms ring during it, allow them in the phone\'s settings:
A short report on your phone and the checks, for you to share if you want. Nothing is sent automatically.
What happened to each alert, to find out why one was late. No titles or notes; it stays on your phone.

Choose a reminder to see its details

%1$s in the morning or the evening?

Voice input uses your phone\'s speech service. That service may use the internet if the language pack is not installed on the phone. Remember Me itself sends nothing and does not ask for the microphone permission.
There is no voice input service on this phone.
A template only fills in the fields. Nothing is saved before “Save”.
Save any reminder as a template from the ⋮ menu of the editor, and it shows here.
Only the template is deleted; no reminder changes.
Rings even when the phone is silent
If Android does not allow it, you get a normal notification.
Then the sound stops, the reminder stays, and it sounds again as set in Sound again.
Six choices on the reminder screen and in the notification; Remember Me for Windows sees them too. The first is the quick Snooze.
It is hidden from an hour before its time. The earliest allowed time is 1:00 AM.

The copies are not encrypted. Turn on Encrypt copies to protect them with a password.
The copies are encrypted with your password.
The newest 5 copies are kept in the folder. Remember Me never goes online; if the folder syncs to an account, that account\'s app uploads it.
With a password. Remember Me for Windows cannot open encrypted copies yet

Choose a password for your copies. If you forget it, the copy cannot be restored in any way. Remember Me for Windows cannot open encrypted copies yet. The password is kept on this phone, protected by an Android system key, so the automatic copy can be encrypted without asking you.
The password could not be stored on this phone, so encryption stays off.

On this phone everything stays as it is.

This file is not a calendar file.
Nothing in this file can be added.

Everything is removed from this phone: reminders, trash, safety copies, logs, copied tones, settings and the copy password, and every alarm and notification is cancelled. This cannot be undone. Copies you saved as files outside the app stay. Save a copy first if you want.
This replaces your current reminders (%1$s). A safety copy is saved first.
The file is damaged: it does not match its saved checksum, or it changed after it was encrypted.
This copy is from a newer Remember Me. Update the app, then try again.
The copy did not open with this password. Nothing was changed.
Type the password you chose when this copy was saved.
All your data stays on your phone. Remember Me has no internet permission: it sends nothing anywhere and collects no statistics.

Remember Me does not record sound and has no microphone permission. When you tap the voice button, Android opens your phone\'s speech recognition service, which returns only the text. That service may send your voice to its company if it cannot work offline; we ask it to work offline when it can.
A copy is saved only where you choose. It is not encrypted unless you turn on Encrypt copies. The compatibility report is sent only if you share it yourself.
To show a reminder when it is due, with Done and Snooze.
So a reminder arrives at the minute you chose, not later.
The same permission on Android 12 only, where it has another name.
To show a reminder full screen while the phone is locked. You can turn it off in Settings.
To set your reminders\' alarms again after the phone restarts.
So the phone vibrates with a reminder if you want.
So Android can ask you to allow unrestricted battery use and reminders are not delayed. Nothing happens without your yes.

To play the reminder\'s chosen tone in a short service that stops by itself after the ring length (2 minutes at most), or at once on Done, Snooze, a swipe or a volume key. Nothing keeps running in the background afterwards, and there is no internet.
No internet: the app sends and receives nothing
No location: you choose the prayer city
No access to your files except the one you pick
No microphone, camera, contacts or calendar
Shared with Remember Me for Windows

The reminders stay, without this tag.
